# Discover the Ultimate Pickleball Experience and More!
- Unleash your creativity and fitness with our configurable custom physics engine. Whether you're aiming for precision, training for excellence, or just having fun, our platform has it all, with **9** sports and **27** environments to explore.
{3771787856372411}
# Key Features:
- AI-Powered Pickleball: Experience outrageous rallies and exciting gameplay with our advanced AI Bots and **Multiplayer** for Singles and Doubles, with **instant replay**.
{1714346862674368}
- Realistic Gameplay: Use your real-life forehand, backhand, dinks, and volleys to enhance your skills with **custom grip** adapters.
- Ambidextrous Play: Perfect for left, right-handed and ambidextrous players.
- **Single controller play** for double handed shots.
- **Ball machine with custom shot editor**: Take on several drills with a fully programmable ball machine. 
{526989036877632}
- **Practice Wall & Mirror mode**: Hone your skills with endless practice. Challenge yourself with different perspectives.
{559682220101194}
- **Over 50 leaderboards**: ranked daily, weekly, and all-time scores.
- Configurable Settings: Display fault trajectory, ball trail, etc.
# Multiplayer:
- Skill-based **matchmaking** worldwide.
- Invite friends
- Create and join courts for pickup games.

# Fitness Tracker:
- Keeps a 7-day history of balls hit and minutes played

# Eight unlockable sports:
- Padel
- Badminton
- Baseball
- Cricket
- Zombies First Person Shooter
- Racquetball
- Paddleball
- Handball

changelog.change_log: Hide review button once review is found
Add player height adjustment. Bugfix turn on matchmaking by default for players with >500 points. Fix language translation of Courts.
Bugfix Bot serve position in Padel. Update materials of Padel, Racquetball and Badminton racquets. Update Welcome Dialog.
Bugfix initial position in Cricket and Baseball.
Delay player reset by 0.5 seconds after point ends. Long press of B button on right controller will reset player position back to baseline.

Wait for bot to settle into receiving position before allowing player to serve. Improve safe gaming dialog. Allow ball machine and custom drills with randomized bullseye target instead of cones and cube targets
Improve Bot shot selection. Pause bot when menu is open.
Update teleportation in Badminton. Update terminal scene

Update Bot physics so the bot hits balls out more for realism and varies the speed of shots more. Balls won't pass through bots body for more realistic simulation. Improve zombies game so chanMutant and ChaserEye can be cut with Light Saber.
Bugfix regression in multiplayer bounce before net fault detection.
Update safe gaming notice at boot. Bugfix previous button on leaderboard.
Dim lights in terminal scene. Improve player alignment function.
Add unlockable Terminal background scene. Hide menu when welcome dialog is shown.

Bugfix missing skybox in Paddleball. Add feature to reset player position by pressing Y button in Paddleball and Zombies. Move exit function in Zombies and Paddleball to menu button on left controller.
